end.summary:
Reyansh understood that a solid can show different top, front and side views.
Reyansh matched top, front and side views to objects; this was shown on a new-situation question.
Reyansh practised explaining why views change from different places; this is not steady yet and needs checking next time.
Reyansh first included a hidden object part in a view, then corrected this later; the idea that an object looks the same from every side still needs revisiting.
end.parentNote: Asha practised faces and views using familiar objects such as a ball, cone, cylinder, glass and box. Reyansh used the method of focusing on the shape visible from each viewing place, and later corrected the mix-up about including a part that could not be seen. They still said an object may look the same from every side, so at home, show one object from three places and ask, “What can you see from here, and what cannot you see?”
